newsitem.title: USA: ViroPharma files for two million shares.
newsitem.headline: ViroPharma files for two million shares.

text.p: ViroPharma Inc filed Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration to sell up to two million common shares.
The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 300,000 additional shares. The offering will be made through J.P. Morgan & Co and Cowen & Co.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 11,148,911 common.

Net proceeds will be used for the further development of pleconaril, including clinical trials and certain premarketing activities, ongoing research and development programs and general corporate purposes, which may include capital equipment expenditures.

ViroPharma, based in Malvern, Pa., is a development stage company engaged in the discovery and development of proprietary antiviral pharmaceuticals for the treatment of diseases caused by RNA viruses.
